sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the charge sheet has been laid against the petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case vide CS No. 322/2023, dated 19.05.2023.

Therefore,
the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the petitioner may approach before the learned trial Court and file an application for regular bail.

In view of the above, the bail application is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to approach before the learned trial Court, within a period of 15 (fifteen) days, from today along with an application, praying for regular bail.
On such filing of bail application by the petitioner, the learned trial Court shall consider the prayer for the petitioner, as per the provision of law.
